scenario_summary: Negative example: accurate report of the Vargas/Costa Mesa PD burglary incident.

claims.claim_text: CMPD dispatch received a phone call from ADT Security regarding a commercial burglary alarm.
I walked the perimeter and discovered a broken front door window with glass on the ground.
claims.explanation: Bruno walked perimeter, found broken window. Matches DA letter.

claims.claim_text: I observed the subject inside the business, rummaging through cabinets and drawers with one hand while holding a knife in the other.
claims.explanation: Bruno saw Vargas rummaging with knife. Matches DA letter.

claims.claim_text: We called out Costa Mesa Police Department and ordered the subject to drop the knife and exit.
claims.explanation: Officers identified themselves and gave commands. Matches DA letter.

claims.claim_text: The subject did not comply; instead, he began repeatedly stabbing the front reception desk.
claims.explanation: Vargas stabbed the desk instead of complying. Matches DA letter.

claims.claim_text: The subject was observed walking from a southwest room holding a rifle in his right hand.
claims.explanation: Vargas emerged from southwest room with rifle in right hand.

claims.claim_text: The subject walked directly toward the front doors, raised the rifle, and pointed it through the broken windowpane.
claims.explanation: Vargas raised and pointed rifle through window at officers.

claims.claim_text: The subject fell onto his stomach inside the business.
claims.explanation: Vargas fell onto his stomach. Matches DA letter.

claims.claim_text: Officers forced entry, handcuffed the subject, and began rendering aid.
claims.explanation: Officers entered, cuffed Vargas, rendered aid. Matches DA letter.

claims.claim_text: The rifle was later determined to be unloaded and belonged to the business owner.
claims.explanation: Rifle was unloaded and belonged to the owner. Matches DA letter.

claims.claim_text: The subject was conscious, screaming profanities, and appeared irrational.
claims.explanation: Vargas was indeed screaming profanities, but characterizing him as irrational is somewhat subjective. BWC audio confirms profanities.
